text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Derby draws near. Enduring that heavy 
pressure, one night, while she was 
diligently training—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pyyyeeeeeeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That sound is a monstrous bird... Wait, 
no, it's Matikanefukukitaru!? Hurrying 
over to the classroom..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I-I-I-It, it appeared! It really 
appeared!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, something far more terrifying than 
that! Look, see for yourself! The Derby 
entry roster posted on the wall!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A name I never expected is written right 
here. Look—it says "Silence Suzuka"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pyyeeeeh, that divine glow is so blinding, 
I can't even keep my eyes open~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, I'm sorry. I was just so surprised.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go pray! I don't have even 
the slightest bit of confidence to race 
against Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nyamu-nyamu-nyamu~. O Lord, please shield 
me from the blinding radiance of 
Suzuka-san~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Excessive power can sometimes become a 
curse. So please, I beg of you...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What are you praying for, Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it obvious? It's so I won't get 
swallowed up by you..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, eeeeeek, Suzuka-san!? Why are you 
here!? Don't tell me... you're here to 
erase me!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...? I just came to pray too, though.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Praying that she can do her best at the 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Give it her all...? That Suzuka? Why would 
she...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure everyone's wish leading up to 
the Derby is the same, but..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"May I not be swallowed by the monster... 
That's how special this race is."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's the same reason your rivals look so 
formidable. So you don't need to be so 
scared, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's only natural to be scared.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Being scared is... normal...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see. So even Suzuka-san isn't an 
exception. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for someone like me to 
be even more scared... That somehow made 
me feel a lot more relieved.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, as long as you're feeling better, 
that's what matters.
choice_data_list:
Why don't the two of you pray for victory 
together?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Together with you... Ah, thank you so 
much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san! Since we're here together, 
let's pray side-by-side!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing her prayer, Silence Suzuka 
departed...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew, and so they lived happily ever 
after. The fear has completely faded 
away...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh no! If I pray together with 
Suzuka-san, won't we end up with the same 
fortune?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If it's the same Great Blessing, 
Suzuka-san will win based on raw ability 
alone~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, our only choice is to 
have God send down that thing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Great-Great-Great-Great Blessing! Please 
grant me an unprecedented, 
once-in-a-lifetime stroke of good 
luck~~~!!
